items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: Gene Ammons was around -- he came back; that was his home.

ctx.x: Gene Ammons was around -- he came back; that was his home. And these cats were just starting ... look, everybody had money in those days, '46 and '47, and like I said, every neighborhood had a little club, had 4 pieces, and musicians were coming out of the woodwork; in fact, they were working -- but it all had to do with tenor saxophone -- trumpet players didn't have too much work, you know, but saxophones had it.
